name: Loyalty Founder Enterprise Co.,Ltd.
summary: Loyalty Founder Enterprise Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based company that specializes in the production, fabrication, and commercialization of high-precision steel molds and stamping dies, primarily utilized for computer and server enclosures. Its market presence extends across Taiwan, the United States, and Mainland China. Beyond its core molding activities, the company also supplies complete data storage and processing systems, alongside fully assembled computers, server chassis, and power supply units. Furthermore, Loyalty Founder maintains a diversified portfolio, engaging in general investment ventures. It actively participates in the import, export, and distribution of various IT equipment, including computers, server enclosures, and their related components, as well as peripherals such as keyboards and scanners, and specialized molds. The company is also involved in the manufacturing, importing, and exporting of electronic and optoelectronic products, precision dies, and intricate injection-molded parts. Established in 1979, Loyalty Founder Enterprise Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.
